topics.title: India and Iran Sign 10-Year Long-Term Contract for Chabahar Port Operations
topics.summary: India Ports Global Limited (IPGL) signed a long-term main contract with Iran's Port and Maritime Organisation (PMO) to equip and operate the Shahid Beheshti Terminal at Chabahar Port for 10 years.
key_points: Provides alternative trade route bypassing Pakistan to Afghanistan and Central Asia.
Crucial component of the International North-South Transport Corridor (INSTC).
Strategic counterweight to China's presence in Pakistan's Gwadar Port.

topics.title: RBI Approves Record Surplus Transfer of ₹2.11 Lakh Crore to Central Government
topics.summary: The Reserve Bank of India's Board approved a dividend payout of ₹2.11 lakh crore to the Union Government for FY24 under the Economic Capital Framework (ECF).
key_points: Framework guided by the Bimal Jalan Committee recommendations.
Contingency Risk Buffer (CRB) raised to 6.5% from 6.0%.
Helps fiscal consolidation efforts and infrastructure funding without widening the fiscal deficit.

topics.title: ISRO Successfully Tests 3D-Printed Liquid Rocket Engine
topics.summary: The Indian Space Research Organisation achieved a milestone by successfully hot-testing a liquid rocket engine produced using Additive Manufacturing Technology (3D printing).
key_points: Engine used in PSLV's PS4 stage.
Reduces manufacturing time by 60% and raw material usage by 97%.
Demonstrates advanced indigenous capabilities in aerospace manufacturing.

topics.title: Supreme Court Clarifies Scope of Governor's Assent to Bills Under Article 200
topics.summary: The Supreme Court deliberated on the timeline and discretionary powers of State Governors regarding withholding assent or referring state legislative bills to the President.
key_points: Article 200 outlines options for Governors: Grant assent, withhold assent, return bill, or reserve for President.
Emphasizes constitutional conventions to prevent legislative deadlocks.
Crucial for federal harmony and center-state relations.

topics.title: Environmental Concerns Raised Over the Great Nicobar Development Project
topics.summary: The mega-infrastructure project at Great Nicobar Island faces scrutiny regarding its potential impact on biodiversity hotspots, primary rain forests, and indigenous tribes like the Shompen.
key_points: Includes a transshipment port, international airport, and power plant.
Involves diversion of sensitive forest land near Campbell Bay and Galathea National Parks.
Balances geopolitical imperatives in the Indian Ocean Region with ecological sustainability.
